author: Tqniz
body:
Dear Staff members of the avic.us server.


Around a couple of months i have been banned for hacking. And that is true.
But i want to make an excuse for hacking on Your server.
A staff member by the name of Jiveh banned me and said if you want to get un banned, do an appeal in some months.
And now i am back for making my appeal.
I am really sorry for hacking on Your server and will never do it again
Please Accept my appeal.
I feel really sorry for doing this..

title: Ban  Appeal

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
I gave you the chance to admit before I started to screenshare you, but you didn't. Therefore, this appeal is not accepted and you'll remain banned. Appeal in around 2 months if you really want to come back.

Regards,
Jiveh
